I have farmed beans on this quarter hectare for many seasons, and I know they grow well enough without chemical fertilizer because they fix their own nitrogen in the soil. I will use my own kept seed from last year because buying new seed for such a small plot does not make sense when cash is needed for maize fertilizer and school fees. My wife and children can handle all the work on this plot — planting, two rounds of weeding, harvesting, and shelling — so I do not need to hire anyone. I will not spray any chemicals because beans on this small plot never suffer badly enough to justify the cost, and there is no water for irrigation here in Ntchisi.
